cohort: 86 women with CMT and 24 controls (friends and unaffected relatives)
finding: Women with CMT experienced higher rates of placenta previa, abnormal fetal presentations, and preterm deliveries compared to controls and the general population, but pregnancy outcome, newborn weight, and health were similar; worsening of CMT during pregnancy was observed in 9.3% of pregnancies, affecting both CMT1A and non-CMT1A subtypes.
birth_weight: No difference from reference population (excluding twins)
